newsitem.title: USA: TransAmerican offers $150 mln for waste co.
newsitem.headline: TransAmerican offers $150 mln for waste co.

text.p: TransAmerican Waste Industries Inc said Thursday it had made another offer to buy Waste Industries Inc for about $150 million in cash and stock.
TransAmerican said it had cancelled its July 18 letter of intent to merge with the company.

It said its new offer would consist of $50 million in cash, about $25 million worth of common shares and $50 million of "additional consideration upon Waste Industries achieving certain earnings goals."

TransAmerican, which processes and disposes of solid waste that is not hazardous, said the company's corporate office would remain in Houston, headed by Tom Fatjo as chairman and Lonnie Poole as chief executive officer and president.
